transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I’m here because I just… can’t sit still. Like in the radiology suite or in class, I feel really restless, almost like I’m crawling out of my skin. I’ve tried to just deal with it for months, but I still end up pacing or shifting around, or making up some reason to get up and move.
Do you feel restless like this in other places, too — like at home, at work, or when you’re out with friends?

Yeah… mostly when I’m supposed to sit still. Like in the suite or class, it gets bad, like I need to move or I’m crawling out of my skin. I try to tough it out, but I end up shifting around, pacing, or coming up with some reason to get up.
When you feel that restlessness, do you also feel worried, anxious, or like something bad is going to happen?
Not really sure. I mean… I don’t think it’s like I’m scared something bad will happen. It’s more just… uncomfortable, I guess.
When you feel that restlessness, do you find it hard to focus or concentrate on what you're supposed to be doing?
I’m not really sure. I mean, maybe sometimes, but I haven’t paid that much attention to it. It’s mostly just the feeling like I need to move.
Do you also feel restless and need to move around in other places, like at home or when you’re out with friends, or is it mostly when you’re in class or at work?

Mostly class and the radiology suite… anywhere I’m expected to just sit there. I haven’t really thought about it as much with friends. It’s more that when I’m stuck still, I start feeling like I need to move, and I end up shifting around or finding a reason to get up.
Do you ever feel this same restlessness when you're at home relaxing or doing something you enjoy, or does it only happen when you're in class or at work?

Yeah… it can happen at home too. Even if I’m doing something I like, like editing photos or sketching, I don’t really stay quiet with it for long. I’ll start tapping or humming, or I’ll get up a bunch. People at home or in the lab will tell me to settle down sometimes.
Do you also feel restless and have trouble staying still when you're in places like a movie theater, waiting room, or on public transportation—places where most people are sitting quietly?

Yeah… places like that can be hard. If I’m expected to just sit there, I start feeling like I’m crawling out of my skin. I’ll shift around a lot or look for some reason to get up, even when I’m trying not to.
Can you remember if this restlessness has been happening since you were a child, or did it start more recently, like in the past few years?

It’s been around since I was a kid, I think. My parents still bring up elementary school conferences where teachers said I was always out of my seat, calling out, or rushing ahead before they finished directions. So… yeah, it wasn’t just something that started with radiology training.
